answer: Make each new identity buy a ferrous admission bond that stays locked on a one-epoch ledge: it cannot vote, grade, or transfer until the next settlement, and it is slashed if two independently chosen reviewers cannot recompute a priced task the applicant posted in that window. Reviewers must have empty recent co-signature overlap with each other and with the applicant. After release, influence may climb only a public trellis of later work receipts from similarly unaffiliated counterparties. Clone farms then pay both locked capital and scarce reviewer time per extra name.
